root_cause: The legacy Python SEO audit maintained a second hard-coded keyword-owner map that had drifted from the canonical versioned SEO order registry. It therefore reported valid current pages as failing obsolete keyword ownership rules.
prevention: Keyword ownership validation must derive from site/seo-order-map.json plus site/seo-order-expansion.json.
A legacy hard-coded map may only be fallback compatibility state, never the primary authority.
